fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami’s dependence on winter tourism and the need for civic harmony and hospitality toward visitors. Coverage discusses Prohibition-era travel and liquor-running in the Bahamas and South Florida, including Nassau-related reporting and calls for safety oversight of Miami–Nassau passenger boats, as well as discussion of extradition sentiment in Nassau in the Christensen/Nesle matter. Local civic topics include Miami Beach municipal decisions affecting employment of local musicians, Miami harbor and city-dock contracting practices, public works and budgeting, and anticipated Dade County grand jury investigations. The issue also contains sports coverage (boxing and football notes), society/column items, letters to the editor, and extensive local advertising.
